_note: Open endless floors (src/dungeon/open_floor.gd). One map per floor: rooms on a grid of cells, joined by 5-tile corridors (CryptGenerator), drawn by the 0x72 crypt renderer. map_tiles: map size in 32 px tiles. grid: cells across and down, one room per used cell. room_count: rooms per floor [min, max], at most grid cells. room_tiles_min / room_margin: smallest room and the gap kept free inside its cell. extra_links: chance per extra neighbour pair to get a second corridor, so the map has loops. enemy_group: sleeping enemies per room [min, max] (none in the start room). chests_per_floor: loot chests [min, max] in rooms that are neither start nor boss room; crates_per_room: crates along walls per room [min, max]. themes: terrain tint per floor, cycled.
